outcome: Maternal outcomes (febrile morbidity, acute kidney injury, mortality)
cohort: 25 women who underwent emergency obstetric hysterectomy (EOH) out of 5584 deliveries at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, BMGMC Shahdol, M.P., between November 2021 and February 2023.
finding: The incidence of EOH was 25 out of 5584 deliveries (0.45%), with uterine rupture (36%) and atonic postpartum hemorrhage (16%) being the most common indications, and maternal mortality of 12% and perinatal mortality of 68%.
